external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Boyer Steel is a proud sponsor of the University of Toledo SAE Team. Using 4130 alloy steel donated by Boyer Steel, the SAE team is constructing their team’s 26th car. Boyer Steel helped the team choose 4130 alloy for it’s yield strength, weld ability, and weight.

University of Toledo SAE Team - Boyer Steel, Inc

Richard Paielli began his career at Boyer Steel in April of 1984 as a warehousemen. While employed at Boyer Steel he studied metallurgy at Macomb Community College. After working various positions to familiarize himself with the company and industry, he was promoted to general manager. In September of 2000 Richard purchased Boyer Steel with his brother-in-law, Michael Desmond. When not working Richard enjoys cycling and walking on the trails near his house with his wife, Karen and their dog, Fre
